fields.help_en: The log source's name (spool folder), with * at its end if needed. A source defined as a network (e.g. ap) also finds its members (ap-<ip>).

fields.help_en: The address of the device that sent the line (unknown senders included).

fields.help_en: The kind of record (traffic, web filter, DHCP …); the types are in the field list.

fields.help_en: The subtype the device sent (e.g. FortiGate forward, local; MikroTik login).

fields.help_en: The host name of the syslog header or the FortiGate devname field.
fields.help_tr: Syslog başlığındaki ya da FortiGate devname alanındaki cihaz adı.

fields.help_en: The syslog program or the MikroTik topics (e.g. dhcp,info).
fields.help_tr: Syslog programı ya da MikroTik konuları (ör. dhcp,info).

fields.help_en: The syslog severity: emerg … debug or 0-7; comparisons work (<=err: errors and more severe).

fields.help_en: The pattern a line could not be parsed with, with * at its end if needed; * alone finds every error.

fields.help_en: The address or network connected to.
fields.help_tr: Bağlanılan adres ya da ağ.
fields.name: dstip

fields.help_en: The FortiGate's address after source NAT (transip).
fields.help_tr: FortiGate'in kaynak NAT sonrası adresi (transip).

fields.help_en: Any of the source, destination or NAT addresses; scanned in UTM records, srcip: is faster for a client.

fields.help_en: The client's port.

fields.help_tr: Kaynak NAT sonrası port; natip: ile birlikte indeksten okunur.
fields.name: natport

fields.help_en: The source or the destination port.
fields.help_tr: Kaynak ya da hedef port.
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: tcp, udp, icmp or the protocol number.

fields.name: proto

fields.help_en: The device's action (deny, blocked, passthrough, assigned, login …). -action:accept finds records whose action is not accept, including those without one.

fields.name: action

fields.help_en: The domain and its subdomains; *.example.com finds only the subdomains.

fields.name: domain

fields.help_en: The exact name asked in DNS (read from an index).

fields.help_en: Text the URL contains.

fields.name: category

fields.help_en: The FortiGate service.
fields.help_tr: FortiGate servis adı (HTTPS, DNS …).
fields.name: service

fields.help_en: The destination's country.
fields.help_tr: Hedefin ülkesi.
fields.name: country

fields.help_en: The FortiGate policy number or name.

fields.name: policy

fields.help_en: The FortiGate session id.
fields.help_tr: FortiGate oturum numarası.
fields.name: sessionid

fields.help_en: The user who signed in to a device or changed it.
fields.help_tr: Cihaza giriş yapan ya da değişiklik yapan kullanıcı.
fields.name: user

fields.help_en: The device's MAC address (any separator) or a vendor prefix.
fields.help_tr: Cihazın MAC adresi (her ayraçla) ya da üretici öneki.
fields.name: mac

fields.help_en: The VLAN of the client address (Devices and persons → VLANs).
fields.help_tr: İstemci adresinin VLAN'ı (Cihazlar ve Kişiler → VLAN'lar).
fields.name: vlan

fields.help_en: The incoming or the outgoing interface.
fields.help_tr: Gelen ya da giden arayüz.
fields.name: interface

fields.help_en: The type of the DNS query (A, AAAA, MX …).
fields.help_tr: DNS sorgusunun tipi (A, AAAA, MX …).
fields.name: qtype

fields.help_en: The name of the IPS signature.
fields.help_tr: IPS imzasının adı.

fields.help_en: The name of the virus found.

fields.name: virus

fields.help_en: The FortiGate logid field.

fields.name: logid

fields.help_en: The event's level (FortiGate level, MikroTik topic level).
fields.help_tr: Olayın seviyesi (FortiGate level, MikroTik konu seviyesi).
